description: This file contains unit tests for the SubscriptionActor class within the org.eclipse.ditto.services.utils.search package. It tests subscription behavior including empty results, multi-page results, cancellation, failures, partial failures, and timeouts, using Akka actors and streams.

classes.name: SubscriptionActorTest
classes.description: Unit test suite for the SubscriptionActor class, testing various subscription scenarios using Akka actors and streams.

methods.name: init
methods.description: Sets up the ActorSystem with specific configuration before each test.

methods.name: cleanup
methods.description: Shuts down the ActorSystem after each test.

methods.name: emptyResults
methods.description: Tests that the actor correctly handles a subscription with no results.

methods.name: twoPages
methods.description: Tests paginated subscription results, verifying correct handling of multiple pages.

methods.name: cancellation
methods.description: Tests the behavior when a subscription is canceled.

methods.name: failure
methods.description: Verifies handling of a subscription failing with an exception.

methods.name: partialFailure
methods.description: Tests handling of partial failure scenarios during streaming.

methods.name: timeout
methods.description: Ensures that timeouts result in the appropriate failure message.

methods.name: newSubscriptionActor
methods.description: Creates a new actor instance of SubscriptionActor with specified timeout for testing.

methods.name: connect
methods.description: Connects a source of JSON arrays to the subscription actor, initiating the test scenario.
